items.title: 1 Internet Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Question
items.summary: Whether it be online shopping or social media, secular forces are propelling consumer internet businesses forward. But it’s not all sunshine and rainbows as consumer purchasing power can make or break demand. This unpredictability is weighing on the industry as its 7.6% return over the past six months has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 11.7% gain.
